text: In Pakistan, a new home still starts as a sketch on paper. Then come weeks of drafts, site visits... and plans rejected for breaking LDA bylaws.
style: slower, reflective, a hint of gravity

text: Meet Naqsha: an agentic home-design studio, built on Google Cloud. Describe your plot once, and walk through your home before the first brick is laid.

It starts with a single message. A Google ADK agent, running Gemini 3.8 Flash, replies in about four seconds with what it understood: the brief floor by floor, a solar-ready roof, the water tank, and the exact envelope LDA lets you build on this plot.
Next, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image draws four exterior directions, all from the same camera and light. All four arrive in about twenty-three seconds, and one tap gives you every concept at night.

Pick one, and Gemini 4 Argon becomes your architect. It lays out every floor as structured data. Our deterministic rules engine checks the plan against LDA bylaws and ten livable-home rules, and Argon fixes what fails: fifteen issues, then five, then zero. Then it reviews a drawing of its own plan, the way an architect would.
This real run took four and a half minutes. Out comes a dimensioned plan that passes every LDA check, with the evidence on screen, and a print-ready drawing set at one to one hundred.

Argon then writes the house in 3D, as code. Twenty-eight sections, streamed and assembled right in the browser. Orbit it, and the neighbours ghost out of the way. Switch to night, cut away a floor, or press Render this view, for a photoreal AI render of that exact angle in under ten seconds.
Then walk it, like a game. Look around, jump to any room with the navigator, take the stairs past the glass guard, and step out through the roof door onto the terrace.
Pin a note to anything in 3D. Share a client link, and family can comment without an account. Here, Ammi asks for a bigger kitchen, and her note reaches the owner live.

Select the notes, and press Revise. A Google ADK agent on Gemini 4 Argon, with nine tools, reads each note, edits the plan, and re-runs every check. The window grows, the kitchen widens, and when a request would break the law, it says so: the porch can't cross the ten-foot LDA front setback, so it offers an alternative.
You can also just type what you want. Version five: a bigger kitchen, thirty-seven of thirty-seven LDA checks, and ten of ten livable.

Under the hood, one Cloud Run service runs the API and the app, and streams the long agent runs. Firestore keeps projects, versions and comments; Cloud Storage holds the images; Firebase Authentication signs people in; and Gemini runs on Vertex AI, orchestrated with Google ADK.
Naqsha turns weeks of drafts and rejections into one agentic session, changing how Pakistan designs its homes. Try it live.
